_doc: TEMPLATE-CODE-ONLY-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-21): the template a new system clones carries deployable code and agent instructions only. The company's own IP, legal, business and strategy papers live in the private ops repository (admin/). Consumer: foundation/template.py (python3 -m foundation template --check, a step in checks.yml).
quote: I thought the UltraStable template repo should be just code that can be deployed for any project. Instructions are fine, but does the IP need to be in the template?

instance_data._doc: Live data Ultrastable's own loops read stays with its instance manifest, never at the template root.
instance_data.instances/ultrastable/funding/: funding registry, procedure, application packets, investor evidence (was business/funding/, business/investor/evidence.json)
instance_data.instances/ultrastable/briefing/: pitch and FAQ sources the social calendar quotes (was business/briefing/)
instance_data.instances/ultrastable/name-clearance.jso: trademark clearance record the name-clearance blind-spot probe reads (was ip/name-clearance.json)

seed_generic._doc: Files the seed renders for every new system. They carry placeholders, never one instance's facts.

same_bytes._doc: The kit a new system clones carries the canonical license, byte for byte.
